text.Mais au fait, comment ça roule ?: So how does it actually work?
text.Pas de moteur à explosion, pas de boîte: No combustion engine, no gearbox, far fewer moving parts. Energy follows a simple chain, from the plug to the wheels.
text.Le courant alternatif (AC) du réseau arr: Alternating current (AC) from the grid arrives through the cable, at home or at a charging point.
text.Il convertit l'AC en courant continu (DC: It converts AC into direct current (DC). On a fast charger, this conversion happens inside the charger.
text.Des milliers de cellules lithium stocken: Thousands of lithium cells store the energy, measured in kWh. 50 to 80 kWh on a typical compact car.
text.Il retransforme le DC en AC pour piloter: It turns DC back into AC to drive the motor precisely, to the thousandth of a second.
text.Couple immédiat, rendement proche de 90: Instant torque, efficiency close to 90%. When braking, it becomes a generator and recharges the battery.
text.La batterie représente une large part du: The battery accounts for a large share of the car's price. The chemistry determines range, lifespan, cost and charging speed.
text.Plus chère, dépend du cobalt et du nicke: More expensive, depends on cobalt and nickel
text.Moins chère, très durable, recharge à 10: Cheaper, very durable, happy to charge to 100%
text.Plus lourde, moins à l'aise par grand fr: Heavier, less comfortable in very cold weather
text.Sans lithium ni cobalt, bon comportement: No lithium or cobalt, good in the cold
text.Premières petites voitures, surtout en C: First small cars, mainly in China
text.Promesse de plus d'autonomie, de sécurit: Promises more range, safety and fast charging
text.Production de masse non maîtrisée, coût: Mass production not yet mastered, cost
text.La grande majorité des recharges se fait: The vast majority of charging happens at home or at work. Fast chargers are mainly used on long trips.
text.Dépannage uniquement. Environ 15 km récu: Emergency use only. About 15 km added per hour.
text.La solution idéale : batterie pleine en: The ideal solution: a full battery overnight, at off-peak rates.
text.Parkings, commerces, voirie. Pratique pe: Car parks, shops, streets. Handy while shopping or at the office.
text.Autoroutes et grands axes. De 10 à 80 %: Motorways and main roads. From 10 to 80% in 20 to 40 minutes depending on the car.
text.Coût de cette recharge · autonomie ajout: Cost of this charge · range added
text.Estimations indicatives : pertes de char: Rough estimates: 10% charging losses included, petrol at €1.85/L. On fast chargers, real power drops beyond 50 to 60% charge, hence the calculation up to 80%.
text.La voiture électrique est aussi un ordin: An electric car is also a computer on wheels. Here are the technologies worth knowing, already here or on their way.
text.En doublant la tension, on réduit l'inte: Doubling the voltage reduces current and heat. The result: shorter fast-charging stops and lighter cables.
text.La voiture devient une batterie mobile :: The car becomes a mobile battery: powering an appliance (V2L), a house, or feeding power back to the grid at peak times (V2G).
text.Elle chauffe l'habitacle en consommant t: It heats the cabin using three times less energy than a resistive heater. A real range gain in winter.
text.Comme un smartphone, la voiture reçoit d: Like a smartphone, the car receives updates over the mobile network: new features, better battery management, fixes.
text.On branche, la borne reconnaît la voitur: Plug in, the charger recognises the car and bills automatically. No more cards and multiple apps.
text.Radars, caméras et logiciels assurent ré: Radars, cameras and software provide adaptive cruise control, lane keeping and emergency braking. The driver remains responsible.
text.Depuis le 1er juillet 2025, le bonus éco: Since 1 July 2025, France's eco-bonus has been replaced by the "coup de pouce" incentive for electric private vehicles, funded by energy suppliers through energy-saving certificates (CEE).
text.Selon les revenus du ménage, pour une vo: Depending on household income, for a new car eligible under the eco-score. The discount is deducted directly by the dealer.
text.Bonus supplémentaire pour les modèles éq: An extra bonus for models fitted with a battery made in Europe.
text.Depuis le 1er septembre 2026, une aide C: Since 1 September 2026, a CEE incentive also supports buying or leasing a used electric car, with no income conditions.
text.Les montants varient selon les marques,: Amounts vary by brand, as each works with its own funding partner. Always check the exact offer with the seller before signing.
text.« L'autonomie ne suffit pas au quotidien: "The range is not enough for everyday life"
text.Un Français parcourt en moyenne moins de: The average French driver covers less than 40 km a day. A recent EV offers 300 to 600 km of range: most drivers only charge once or twice a week.
text.Faux. Les constructeurs garantissent gén: False. Manufacturers usually guarantee the battery for 8 years or 160,000 km with at least 70% capacity. In practice, degradation often stays moderate well beyond that.
text.La France a dépassé les 200 000 points d: France passed 200,000 public charging points in July 2026, including more than 5,000 at 350 kW or more. Availability can still improve (89% of points operational in July 2026).
text.Elles se recyclent : lithium, nickel et: They can: more than 90% of the lithium, nickel and cobalt can be recovered with current industrial processes. Before that, many get a second life in stationary storage.
text.« Une électrique pollue autant qu'une th: "An EV pollutes as much as a petrol car"
text.Sa fabrication émet plus de CO₂, surtout: Building one emits more CO₂, mainly because of the battery. But in France, with very low-carbon electricity, that debt is repaid within a few years of use, and then the advantage keeps growing.
text.Kilowattheure : quantité d'énergie stock: Kilowatt-hour: the amount of energy stored. It is the "size of the tank".
text.Kilowatt : puissance. Sur une borne, c'e: Kilowatt: power. On a charger, it is the "flow rate of the pump".
text.Cycle d'homologation européen qui donne: The European test cycle that gives the official range. In real life, expect 10 to 20% less on the motorway.
text.State of Charge : niveau de charge de la: State of Charge: the battery's charge level as a percentage.
text.State of Health : état de santé de la ba: State of Health: the battery's condition compared with its capacity when new. Key when buying used.
text.Prise standard européenne pour la rechar: The European standard plug for DC fast charging.
The European standard plug for AC charging (home, public AC chargers).
text.Conduite à une pédale : relâcher l'accél: One-pedal driving: lifting off the accelerator brakes strongly thanks to energy recovery.
text.Une pastille verte frappée d'un éclair,: A green disc with a lightning bolt, and the name as one word: the green "n" reads as "and". Tech and Watt, technology and energy.
text.Le nom passe en blanc, le « n » en vert: The name turns white, the "n" bright green.
For print or on a photo.
text.Une seule famille pour tout le site et l: A single typeface for the whole site and the logo, close to Apple's: SemiBold for headings and the name, Regular for body text, and SemiBold for the "n" too, simply in green.
